client.business_model: Multi-brand residential home-services platform providing HVAC, plumbing and electrical repair, replacement and maintenance
client.sponsor_pe_firm: Trive Capital and LP First Capital
client.client_history: Cascade Residential Services LLC was formed in December 2022 through a partnership between Trive Capital and LP First Capital to acquire and integrate family-owned HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors. At inception it acquired four Florida contractors and has since expanded to 13 brands, opening a corporate headquarters in Tampa, Florida in February 2024.

revenue.notes: No revenue figure was disclosed in company documents, press releases, or reputable databases searched.

locations.source: CascadeServices.com press release (Feb 2024) announcing headquarters opening and noting the platform comprises 13 brands
locations.notes: Each brand operates as a separate branch in its local market; no separate facilities count published, so brand count is used as the best available proxy for locations.

employees.notes: Site states the platform 'employs over 500 people'. No other independent counts located.
